headlines.title: Are Stronger Smoke Free Sales Altering The Investment Case For Philip Morris International (PM)?
headlines.summary: Philip Morris International reported third quarter 2026 sales of US$11.4b with net income of US$3.3b, while smoke free products and margin expansion supported what management described as strong results and an upgraded full year adjusted EPS outlook.

headlines.title: Philip Morris Reports Q3 Earnings: ETFs in Focus
headlines.summary: Philip Morris delivered better-than-expected Q3 results, but geopolitical risks remain. Discover ETFs with significant exposure to the company.

description: Philip Morris International Inc. operates as a tobacco company. The company offers cigarettes and smoke-free products, including heat-not-burn, e-vapor, and oral nicotine products under the IQOS, VEEV, and ZYN brands; and consumer accessories, such as lighters and matches. It also offers wellness products. The company was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut.
